name: Hornero Network Monitor
description: Network Monitor 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a download oscilloscope and upload trace from the shared Telemetry history with peak readouts, plus current speeds and session totals. Read-only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Deprecated: Retired: Network Scope is the maintained network instrument (dual oscilloscope, Wi-Fi signal, session totals) with typed settings.

PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: cue-toned download oscilloscope and upload sparkline over the shared Telemetry history with the scale stated in the eyebrow. The sampleSeconds setting and Clear history button are removed (history is the shared window).
Dashboard card on the shared Network facade: 1.x speeds and session totals plus history sparkline, peak readouts, honest unavailable state, typed settings and Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card with download/upload speeds and session totals from the PluginKit Network service.

deprecation.message: Retired: Network Scope is the maintained network instrument (dual oscilloscope, Wi-Fi signal, session totals) with typed settings.

showSessionTotals.description: Show downloaded/uploaded session totals from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the download oscilloscope, upload trace and peak readouts from the shared telemetry history.
